walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Edexcel IGCSE GCSE Chemistry specification.

Principles of Chemistry appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Principles of Chemistry in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Edexcel IGCSE board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Principles of Chemistry.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
